title: Resumable observable SimulationRunner (tracing + JSON log + checkpoint/resume)
description:
## Goal

Make the shared simulation harness in
`crates/gf2-coding/src/simulation.rs` observable and resumable so
multi-hour campaign runs can be launched unattended, tailed live, and
recover from crashes / interrupts without recomputing finished SNR
points. The features land at the shared `SimulationRunner` layer so
every future code type (DVB-T2 BICM, 5G NR polar, regular LDPC demo,
BCH curves) benefits.

## Context

`SimulationRunner` currently offers `run_uncoded_ber`,
`run_uncoded_ber_with_channel`, `run_coded`, `run_coded_iterative`,
`run_coded_iterative_parallel`. Output goes to in-memory
`SimulationResults` and an optional CSV write at the end. Logging is
`println!`-style and not structured. There is no checkpoint file, no
resume path, no graceful-shutdown handling. A 10⁶-frame campaign at
the deepest SNR point of a DVB-T2 sweep can run for hours; losing
that to a SIGKILL is unacceptable on the team's hardware budget.

This task does NOT change existing public signatures except by
addition. All current callers (LDPC AWGN demo, BCH curves, modem
harness) continue to compile and pass tests unchanged. New behaviour
is opt-in via new `SimulationConfig` fields.

## Path-scoping note (amended 2026-05-27 per user approval)

The within-SNR heartbeat + SIGINT-flush + deterministic-mid-SNR-resume
semantics depend on a single observable per-SNR loop that owns a
seekable RNG (`ChaCha20Rng::set_word_pos`). The four runner entry
points split as follows:

- `run_coded` / `run_coded_iterative` / `run_with_decoder` — full
  per-SNR + within-SNR (heartbeat) checkpointing via
  `simulate_single_point_observable` and ChaCha20 RNG seek.
- `run_uncoded_ber_with_channel` — per-SNR-boundary checkpointing
  only. The uncoded path is fast (no decoder iterations) and the
  spec's heartbeat criterion is scoped out for this entry point;
  mid-SNR resume simply re-runs the in-flight SNR point.
- `run_coded_iterative_parallel` — per-SNR-boundary checkpointing
  only. The rayon-parallel architecture uses per-worker `StdRng`
  (no `set_word_pos`); within-SNR heartbeat resume is architecturally
  unavailable here. Users needing mid-SNR recovery must use
  `run_coded_iterative` (sequential).

## Deliverables

1. New `SimulationConfig` fields:
   - `checkpoint_dir: Option<PathBuf>` — directory; if `Some`, the
     runner writes per-SNR checkpoint files and resumes from any
     existing ones on startup.
   - `tracing_log_path: Option<PathBuf>` — JSON-lines tracing output.
   - `heartbeat_every_frames: Option<usize>` — emit a within-SNR
     progress event every N simulated frames (within-SNR opt-in;
     None = per-SNR-point coarse-grain only). **Honored only by the
     sequential coded paths per the path-scoping note above.**
2. Checkpoint format: one JSON file per SNR point under
   `<checkpoint_dir>/snr_<index>.json`, containing the canonical SNR
   value, completed frame count, error count, accumulated iteration
   stats, RNG state snapshot, and a content hash of the
   `SimulationConfig` (config-mismatch detection).
3. Resume behaviour: on startup with `checkpoint_dir = Some(p)`, the
   runner reads each existing `snr_<i>.json`, verifies the config
   hash, and either skips finished points or continues from a partial
   point if `heartbeat_every_frames` is set. Mismatched config hash
   aborts with a clear error.
4. `tracing` instrumentation:
   - span per campaign with config hash and run UUID,
   - span per SNR point with eb_n0_db / es_n0_db, frames_target,
     errors_target,
   - event on SNR completion with FER, BER, mean iterations, elapsed,
   - event per heartbeat with progress counters.
   All emitted via the `tracing` crate; subscriber configured to write
   JSON lines to `tracing_log_path` when set.
5. SIGINT / SIGTERM handling: handler flushes the current SNR
   checkpoint before exiting non-zero (so resume is safe). Wrapped
   via `ctrlc` or `signal-hook`, whichever is lighter and stable on
   MSRV 1.95. **Polled within the sequential coded observable loop;
   the uncoded and parallel paths exit on the next-SNR boundary
   when interrupted.**
6. Deterministic RNG seek: the per-SNR-point RNG is derived as
   `seed = config.seed ^ snr_index ^ frames_completed_at_checkpoint`
   (or equivalent) so a resumed point produces the same sequence it
   would have if uninterrupted. Document the derivation in rustdoc.

## Success criteria

- [hard] All existing callers of `SimulationRunner` continue to
  compile and pass tests unchanged (workspace `cargo nextest run
  --workspace --all-features --release --profile ci`).
- [hard] Integration test: run a short multi-point AWGN BPSK campaign
  to completion (small frame counts), then re-run with the same
  config — second run completes near-instantly because all
  checkpoints exist and validate.
- [hard] Resume-after-kill test: spawn a campaign in a subprocess,
  send SIGINT after the first SNR point completes, restart with the
  same config, and assert that the final CSV is byte-identical to a
  reference uninterrupted run with the same seed. **Test may carry
  `#[ignore = "slow: ..."]` per project CLAUDE.md test-tier rule;
  the slow tier enforces it.**
- [hard] Config-mismatch detection: change one config field, retry
  resume, verify the runner errors with a clear message and does not
  overwrite existing checkpoints. **Per-file hash mismatch aborts
  with a clear error rather than silently ignoring the checkpoint.**
- [hard] Within-SNR heartbeat events are emitted at the configured
  cadence; integration test asserts the count of heartbeat events for
  a known-size run. **Scoped to the sequential coded paths
  (`run_coded` / `run_coded_iterative` / `run_with_decoder`) per the
  path-scoping note. The uncoded and parallel entry points are
  per-SNR-boundary only.**
- [hard] JSON tracing log is valid JSON-lines (each line a complete
  JSON object); test parses the log and asserts span / event
  structure. Tests cover the sequential coded path PLUS the uncoded
  and parallel paths' campaign / per-SNR span emission.
- [hard] New dependencies (`tracing`, `tracing-subscriber`, signal
  handler crate) gate behind feature `sim-observability` (default on)
  so embedded users can opt out.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md `gf2-coding` module map and rustdoc updated to
  describe the resume, tracing, and signal-handling surface,
  **including the path-scoping note above (which entry points
  support within-SNR heartbeat and which are per-SNR-boundary only).**
- [hard] No new `unsafe`; crate-level `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` is
  preserved.

## Non-goals

- No live TUI, progress bar, or terminal UI of any kind.
- No distributed / cluster execution.
- No per-frame checkpoint (frame counter is checkpointed at heartbeat
  cadence only).
- No compression of checkpoint files (JSON, plain text on disk).
- No metrics-system integration (Prometheus / OpenTelemetry); tracing
  JSON is the sole structured output.
- **Converting `run_coded_iterative_parallel`'s per-worker `StdRng`
  to `ChaCha20Rng` for within-SNR heartbeat support — out of scope;
  user must use the sequential coded path for that semantic.**
